Headline: #119 Michigan/119th Temporary Reroute at 119th/Wentworth
ShortDescription: #119 Michigan/119th buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, street blockage near 119th/Wentworth.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#119 Michigan/119th buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Michigan, 115th, Wentworth, 119th and resume the normal route, due to street blockage near 119th/Wentworth.

Allow extra travel time.
